thermal_screen.formula: Vdot=Q/(rho*cp*dT); total slot velocity=Vdot/A. Shared inlet; each branch must be sized separately from its own heat duty.
thermal_screen.fan_selection: No duty point selected. Sum core, intake, screen, shroud, duct and louver losses at each required branch flow; intersect with supplier installed fan curve. Motor input=P_air/efficiency; P_air=Vdot*deltaP. No numeric fan power without pressure and efficiency.
